bias.en: Rebound · MACD crossed up, under the SAR
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，仍低于抛物线 SAR

read.en: Arm fell 1.8% on Nov 12 to $199.78, trading $190.00–204.77 on light volume (0.67x the 20-day average). It is above the 5-day ($189.1) and 10-day ($190.9) and below the 30-day ($229.7), 100-day ($263.5) and 200-day ($232.4); only the 200-day is rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($208.02), and RSI is 43.3.

No level broke: the $204.77 high stalled under the SAR and the $190.00 low held the 10-day. Resistance is $204.8–209.5 (Nov 12 high, SAR, Nov 4 high), then $219.4 (Aug 3 low) and $229.7 (30-day). Support is $196.1–196.8 (Nov 2 low and close), then $188.4–191.8 (5 and 10-day) and $181.5–183.2. A close above $209.5 would flip the SAR and target $219; below $188.4, $181.5–183.
read.zh: 关键位未被突破：盘中高点 $204.77 受阻于抛物线 SAR 下方，盘中低点 $190.00 守住 10 日均线。阻力为 $204.8–209.5（11月12日高点、抛物线 SAR、11月4日高点），其次 $219.4（8月3日低点）和 $229.7（30 日均线）。支撑为 $196.1–196.8（11月2日低点和收盘），其次 $188.4–191.8（5 日和 10 日均线）和 $181.5–183.2。若收盘站上 $209.5，抛物线 SAR 将翻多，下一目标看 $219；若跌破 $188.4，则看 $181.5–183。

r.en: Nov 12 high $204.77; Parabolic SAR $208.02; Oct 22 low $208.3; Nov 4 high $209.5
